day_shape: 94 items: US Treasury's 'Operation Economic Outcast' hits Iran's rail, auto and metals sectors plus MODAFL procurement network, Defa Press claims Emirati supertanker struck off Oman, UK summoned over Starmer RAF-plot remarks, IDF names 170 Gaza 'journalists' as militants, Trump floats post-midterm bombing.

threads.label: US Treasury expands Iran sanctions
threads.summary: The State Department announced Operation Economic Outcast designations targeting Iran's rail, automotive and metals networks across the Middle East, East Asia and Europe. OFAC separately sanctioned 10 individuals and entities for procuring weapons components for Iran's MODAFL.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker strike claims
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB said a 2.5-million-barrel supertanker was struck 8km off Oman and that three Emirati-linked tankers — AL RUWAIS, SINBAD and MERSIN PROSPERITY — were on a PGSA non-compliance list. Brent was reported up four dollars to $102.

threads.label: UN veto fallout on Iran sanctions panel
threads.summary: UK Ambassador Sarah MacIntosh told the UN General Assembly that UN sanctions on Iranian proliferation remain fully in force despite Russian and Chinese vetoes of the Panel of Experts' mandate renewal. The Assembly debated the vetoes under its veto initiative.

threads.label: UK-Iran diplomatic clash over RAF plot
threads.summary: British counter-terrorism police arrested a UK-Iranian dual national over a thwarted attack on an RAF airbase, per Jerusalem Post. Defa Press said Tehran summoned Ambassador Hugo Shorter to protest Prime Minister Starmer's remarks.

threads.label: Trump floats renewed Iran bombing
threads.summary: Trump told TIME that resuming large-scale bombing of Iran after the November midterms was 'possible' and rejected Tehran's latest ceasefire proposal, while separately claiming he eliminated Iran's nuclear threat in a single night. Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Baqaei called Trump's worldview a threat to world peace.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and 'journalists' dossier
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed 70 operatives in Gaza in September, including two October 7 participants and an Islamic Jihad rocket operative in Khan Younis. It also published a dossier naming 170 Gazans killed during the war whom it identifies as members of Hamas, PIJ and other groups.

threads.label: US withdrawal from Iraq amplified by Tehran
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported the end of 23 years of US military presence in Iraq. Defa Press and IRIB ran statements from Hezbollah, IRGC commanders Hassan-zade and Naghdi, and former ambassador Kazemi Qomi framing the withdrawal as a resistance victory.

events.title: A Hamas terrorist who participated in the October 7 onslaught, and was claimed as a journalist, was killed in an Israeli airstrike in the southern Gaza Strip yesterday, the military says. The strike in Khan Younis killed Mohammad al-Najar, who Palestinian media identified after his death as a journalist. The IDF says Najar, as a member of Hamas's military wing, invaded Israel on October 7, 2023. Najar had been advancing attacks on troops and Israeli civilians, and attempting to restore Hamas capabilities, "while systematically violating the ceasefire agreement," the military says.
